projects.name: Home Aeroponics & IoT automation
projects.description: An integrated aeroponics lab combining sensor electronics, C++ firmware, Python automation, MQTT and Home Assistant monitoring.
projects.scope: The photographs document the wider historical lab. The public repositories are selected archival snapshots, not the complete installation or proof of a currently buildable or safety-tested system.

repositories.label: Controllers and integration
repositories.description: Python/MQTT climate-device controllers and sanitized Mosquitto and Zigbee2MQTT examples.
repositories.scope: Historical snapshot; not the complete Home Assistant configuration. No integration or physical-safety validation claimed.

repositories.label: Sensor firmware
repositories.description: Five archived Arduino prototypes for light sensing, water-sensor telemetry and relay-command experiments.
repositories.scope: Experimental 2024 source variants, not final solutions or build-verified releases. Dependencies, incomplete integrations and hardware-safety limitations are documented per sketch.

variants.name: Light sensors with JSON/MQTT
variants.scope: Arduino Uno R4 WiFi prototype; missing modified sensor library, undefined software-I2C instances and unregistered message callback.

variants.name: Light sensors with Serial output
variants.scope: Four TCS34725 sensors through separate software-I2C buses; modified Adafruit dependency is absent. No MQTT.

variants.name: pH and relay commands
variants.scope: Serial-controlled relay experiment with pH readings. No MQTT; calibration and relay states are not hardware-validated.

variants.name: EC/TDS and Serial1 relay commands
variants.scope: Water-sensor and relay experiment. MQTT connects but does not publish telemetry in this variant.

variants.name: pH and moisture telemetry
variants.scope: pH and two analog moisture inputs with averaging and JSON/MQTT. Calibration, conversion and periodic reset remain unverified.
